set.t: The 1902 Pioneer Collections telling predates the 1936-37 articles and names the landowner (N. G. Phillips), so the post site can be fixed from the Phillips tract on an 1870s-90s plat.
pinev: East-bank gullies at the Cole Rd crossing of the Shiawassee, sec 6 Burns Twp T5N R4E (LSJ 1937 and USGS Corunna SE 1972 topo); r 350 m
The 1937 article says a few miles SE of Owosso, but the modern Knaggs Bridge is about 10 mi SE: moderate confidence
Post site owned by Hon. N. G. Phillips (1902); tract check pending.
